request: From the Dispatch sheet (Dispatch No, Customer, Planned Date, Actual Date) make an On Time sheet with each Customer, how many of its dispatches have an Actual Date, and how many of those were late (Actual Date after Planned Date), customers A to Z. Customer names are typed in mixed case; rows with no Customer are ignored. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

Check the Dispatch sheet (Dispatch No, Job ID, Planned Date, NCR Check) against the NCR Register (NCR No, Job ID, Status). In the Dispatch sheet write Open NCR in NCR Check for every dispatch whose Job ID has an NCR that is not Closed, and clear it on the others. Job IDs differ in case and stray spaces; a dispatch with no Job ID is left alone. Add the heading if it's missing, and tell me how many dispatches have an Open NCR.

A month-end dispatch report tool, started with one macro. (1) In the Dispatch sheet (Dispatch No, Job ID, Planned Date, Actual Date, Remark) write Late in Remark when the Actual Date is after the Planned Date, Overdue when there is no Actual Date and the Planned Date is before today, and clear Remark on the others. (2) In the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Status, Dispatch Status) write Shipped late when the job has a Late dispatch, Shipped when it has any other dispatch with an Actual Date, Not shipped otherwise. (3) On a Late Dispatches sheet list the Late and Overdue dispatches with the same headings, the earliest Planned Date first. (4) On a Customer Late sheet write each Customer with its number of Shipped late jobs, the most first. (5) Tell me how many dispatches are Overdue. Job IDs differ in case and stray spaces. The output sheets are rebuilt every run.

A calibration and NCR tool, started with one macro. (1) In the Calibration Tracker (Instrument ID, Type, Next Calibration Due, Status) write Overdue in Status when the instrument is overdue, Due soon when it is due in the next 14 days, OK otherwise, and No date when there is no due date. (2) In the NCR Register (NCR No, Instrument ID, Status, Cal Flag) write Overdue instrument in Cal Flag for every NCR that is not Closed and names an Overdue instrument, Unknown instrument when the instrument isn't in the Calibration Tracker, and clear it on the others. (3) On an Overdue Instruments sheet list the Overdue instruments with the same headings, the earliest due date first. (4) On an NCR Instruments sheet write each Instrument ID named in the NCR Register with its number of NCRs, the most first. (5) Tell me how many NCRs I flagged. Instrument IDs differ in case and stray spaces. The output sheets are rebuilt every run.
